    "value": "import React, { Component } from 'react';\nimport { Loader, Row, Col, Message, Icon, Button } from \"uiw\";\n\nclass Demo extends Component {\n  constructor(props) {\n    super(props);\n    this.state = {\n      loading: true,\n    };\n  }\n  render() {\n    return (\n      <div>\n        <Row gutter={10}>\n          <Col>\n            <Button\n              style={{ marginBottom: 10 }}\n              size=\"small\"\n              onClick={() => {\n                this.setState({\n                  loading: !this.state.loading,\n                });\n              }}\n            >\n              点击切换加载状态\n            </Button>\n          </Col>\n        </Row>\n        <Row gutter={10}>\n          <Col fixed>\n            <Loader loading={this.state.loading}>\n              <Message\n                type=\"success\"\n                title=\"成功提示标题\"\n                description={\n                  <span>\n                    <Icon\n                      type=\"uiw\"\n                      verticalAlign=\"baseline\"\n                      style={{ fill: \"#009688\" }}\n                    />\n                    这里是成功提示详情描述。\n                  </span>\n                }\n              />\n            </Loader>\n          </Col>\n          <Col fixed>\n            <Loader loading={this.state.loading}>\n              <Message\n                type=\"warning\"\n                title=\"成功提示标题\"\n                description=\"这里是成功提示详情描述。\"\n              />\n            </Loader>\n          </Col>\n        </Row>\n      </div>\n    );\n  }\n}\nexport default Demo;"

    "value": "import React from 'react';\nimport { Loader, Icon, Button } from \"uiw\";\n\nclass Demo extends React.Component {\n  constructor() {\n    super();\n    this.state = {\n      fullscreen: false,\n    };\n  }\n  render() {\n    return (\n      <div>\n        <Button\n          style={{ marginBottom: 10 }}\n          type=\"primary\"\n          onClick={() => {\n            this.setState(\n              {\n                fullscreen: !this.state.fullscreen,\n              },\n              () => {\n                setTimeout(() => {\n                  this.setState({\n                    fullscreen: !this.state.fullscreen,\n                  });\n                }, 3000);\n              }\n            );\n          }}\n        >\n          显示整页加载，3 秒后消失\n        </Button>\n        {this.state.fullscreen && (\n          <Loader\n            tip=\"加载中...\"\n            size=\"large\"\n            bgColor=\"rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9)\"\n            fullscreen={this.state.fullscreen}\n          />\n        )}\n      </div>\n    );\n  }\n}\n\nexport default Demo;"

    source: "Loader 加载器\n===\n\n[![Buy me a coffee](https://img.shields.io/badge/Buy%20me%20a%20coffee-048754?logo=buymeacoffee)](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/#/sponsor)\n[![Telegram Channel](https://img.shields.io/badge/%20-Telegram-00618f.svg?logo=Telegram)](https://t.me/s/AwesomeMacApps)\n[![Follow On X](https://img.shields.io/badge/Follow%20on%20X-333333?logo=x&logoColor=white)](https://x.com/jaywcjlove)\n[![Open in unpkg](https://img.shields.io/badge/Open%20in-unpkg-blue)](https://uiwjs.github.io/npm-unpkg/#/pkg/@uiw/react-loader/file/README.md)\n[![NPM Downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/@uiw/react-loader.svg?style=flat)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@uiw/react-loader)\n[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@uiw/react-loader.svg?label=@uiw/react-loader)](https://npmjs.com/@uiw/react-loader)\n\n用于页面和区块的加载中状态。\n\n```jsx\nimport { Loader } from 'uiw';\n// or\nimport Loader from '@uiw/react-loader';\n```\n\n### 基础实例\n\n```jsx mdx:preview&bg=#fff\nimport React from 'react';\nimport { Loader } from \"uiw\";\n\nexport default function Demo() {\n  return (\n    <div>\n      <Loader size=\"small\" />\n      <Loader />\n      <Loader size=\"large\" />\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n```\n\n\n### 警告提示中加载\n\n```jsx mdx:preview&bg=#fff\nimport React, { Component } from 'react';\nimport { Loader, Row, Col, Message, Icon, Button } from \"uiw\";\n\nclass Demo extends Component {\n  constructor(props) {\n    super(props);\n    this.state = {\n      loading: true,\n    };\n  }\n  render() {\n    return (\n      <div>\n        <Row gutter={10}>\n          <Col>\n            <Button\n              style={{ marginBottom: 10 }}\n              size=\"small\"\n              onClick={() => {\n                this.setState({\n                  loading: !this.state.loading,\n                });\n              }}\n            >\n              点击切换加载状态\n            </Button>\n          </Col>\n        </Row>\n        <Row gutter={10}>\n          <Col fixed>\n            <Loader loading={this.state.loading}>\n              <Message\n                type=\"success\"\n                title=\"成功提示标题\"\n                description={\n                  <span>\n                    <Icon\n                      type=\"uiw\"\n                      verticalAlign=\"baseline\"\n                      style={{ fill: \"#009688\" }}\n                    />\n                    这里是成功提示详情描述。\n                  </span>\n                }\n              />\n            </Loader>\n          </Col>\n          <Col fixed>\n            <Loader loading={this.state.loading}>\n              <Message\n                type=\"warning\"\n                title=\"成功提示标题\"\n                description=\"这里是成功提示详情描述。\"\n              />\n            </Loader>\n          </Col>\n        </Row>\n      </div>\n    );\n  }\n}\nexport default Demo;\n```\n\n\n### 卡片加载中\n\n```jsx mdx:preview&bg=#fff\nimport React from 'react';\nimport { Loader, Card, Col, Row } from \"uiw\";\n\nexport default function Demo() {\n  return (\n    <Row gutter={10}>\n      <Col fixed>\n        <Card\n          title=\"图标与文字一行显示\"\n          extra={<a href=\"#\">更多</a>}\n          style={{ minWidth: 230 }}\n        >\n          <Loader color=\"red\" tip=\"加载中...\" style={{ width: \"100%\" }}>\n            <div>\n              卡片内容\n              <br />\n              卡片内容\n              <br />\n              卡片内容\n              <br />\n            </div>\n          </Loader>\n        </Card>\n      </Col>\n      <Col fixed>\n        <Card\n          title=\"图标与文字垂直显示\"\n          extra={<a href=\"#\">更多</a>}\n          style={{ minWidth: 230 }}\n        >\n          <Loader tip=\"loading...\" vertical style={{ width: \"100%\" }}>\n            <div>\n              卡片内容\n              <br />\n              卡片内容\n              <br />\n              卡片内容\n              <br />\n            </div>\n          </Loader>\n        </Card>\n      </Col>\n      <Col fixed>\n        <Card\n          title=\"自定义背景颜色\"\n          extra={<a href=\"#\">更多</a>}\n          style={{ minWidth: 230 }}\n        >\n          <Loader\n            bgColor=\"rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4)\"\n            color=\"#fff\"\n            tip=\"loading...\"\n            vertical\n            style={{ width: \"100%\" }}\n          >\n            <div>\n              卡片内容\n              <br />\n              卡片内容\n              <br />\n              卡片内容\n              <br />\n            </div>\n          </Loader>\n        </Card>\n      </Col>\n    </Row>\n  );\n}\n```\n\n\n### 自定义加载图标动画\n\n```jsx mdx:preview&bg=#fff\nimport React from 'react';\nimport { Loader, Card, Icon } from \"uiw\";\n\nexport default function Demo() {\n  return (\n    <div>\n      <Card title=\"Card标题\" extra={<a href=\"#\">更多</a>} style={{ width: 300 }}>\n        <Loader\n          tip=\"加载中...\"\n          color=\"red\"\n          indicator={\n            <Icon\n              type=\"loading\"\n              spin={true}\n              style={{ verticalAlign: \"text-top\" }}\n            />\n          }\n          style={{ width: \"100%\" }}\n        >\n          <div>\n            卡片内容\n            <br />\n            卡片内容\n            <br />\n            卡片内容\n            <br />\n          </div>\n        </Loader>\n      </Card>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n```\n\n\n### 整页加载\n\n页面数据加载时显示。\n\n```jsx mdx:preview&bg=#fff\nimport React from 'react';\nimport { Loader, Icon, Button } from \"uiw\";\n\nclass Demo extends React.Component {\n  constructor() {\n    super();\n    this.state = {\n      fullscreen: false,\n    };\n  }\n  render() {\n    return (\n      <div>\n        <Button\n          style={{ marginBottom: 10 }}\n          type=\"primary\"\n          onClick={() => {\n            this.setState(\n              {\n                fullscreen: !this.state.fullscreen,\n              },\n              () => {\n                setTimeout(() => {\n                  this.setState({\n                    fullscreen: !this.state.fullscreen,\n                  });\n                }, 3000);\n              }\n            );\n          }}\n        >\n          显示整页加载，3 秒后消失\n        </Button>\n        {this.state.fullscreen && (\n          <Loader\n            tip=\"加载中...\"\n            size=\"large\"\n            bgColor=\"rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9)\"\n            fullscreen={this.state.fullscreen}\n          />\n        )}\n      </div>\n    );\n  }\n}\n\nexport default Demo;\n```\n\n\n### Props\n\n| 参数       | 说明 | 类型 | 默认值 |\n| ---------- | ------- | ------- | --------- |\n| size       | 尺寸 | Enum{`small`, `default`, `large`} | `default` |\n| loading    | 是否旋转 | Boolean | `true` |\n| indicator  | 加载指示符，可以加载一个 Icon 动画   | ReactNode | - |\n| tip        | 当作为包裹元素时，可以自定义描述文案 | String  | - |\n| color      | 设置图标与文字的颜色 | String  | - |\n| vertical   | 图标与文字垂直显示 | Boolean | - |\n| bgColor    | 自定义背景颜色 | String  | - |\n| fullscreen | 是否全屏显示 | Boolean | `false` |\n",
    headings:[],
    headingsList:[],
  }
